test_objective: The system generated attributes are included in the response payload body of a notification if sysAttrs parameter is set to true.

test_cases.name: 046_17_01 Check that the response payload body contains the system generated attributes if sysAttrs parameter is set to true
test_cases.doc: The system generated attributes are included in the response payload body of a notification if sysAttrs parameter is set to true.
test_cases.when:
when {
    the SUT receives a Request from the client containing:
        URL set to '/ngsi-ld/v1/entities/{entityId}/attrs/{attributeId}'
        method set to 'PATCH'
        Update Entity Attributes and
    Query Parameter: id set to '${entity_id}' and
    Query Parameter: fragment_filename set to '${fragment_filename}' and
    Query Parameter: content_type set to 'application/ld+json'
}
